rationale: The parties have converged on the need for quantified restructuring and have narrowed the menu to hybrid vs. closure-free vs. closure-led, but the core conflict remains unresolved: labour/state reject closures and forced redundancies, while management/investors/family insist those instruments remain available unless an equivalent alternative is proven. The last two rounds show position-hardening rather than substantive movement, so further free discussion is likely to recycle the same impasse without resolution.
